title: Parents and subagents across Claude and Codex
footer: isolated demo state · namespace showcase-live · IDs are aliases
intro: Each runtime started its own subagent. Relay carried every message.
outro: Four peers, four mailboxes, one namespace. Hosts started the agents; Relay only stored mail and counted acknowledgements for the bound peer.

captions.caption: Same request key retried: same message, duplicate true.
Codex parent sends across providers to the Claude peer.
Task for its own subagent is stored before that subagent exists: send now, read later.
Scoping: codex-sub acknowledging another peer's message counts 0. Peer scoping is not OS authentication.
Same on the Claude side: acknowledged 0 for a message that is not in its mailbox.
The Claude parent delegates to its own subagent through its own mailbox.
Answer to the Codex parent, in the original conversation.
Final acknowledgement by a later session of the same peer.
